What to verify: All P0 anchors (face shape / eye color / hairstyle / skin tone / outfit) match reference sheet
Verification method: Side-by-side comparison of generated panels with reference sheet
Pass criteria: 100% of P0 anchors visible and matching in every panel where character appears
Fail criteria: Any P0 anchor missing or altered (different hairstyle / wrong eye color / outfit changed)
Fix protocol: Re-generate panel with anchor sentence verbatim + add "same character as panel [reference panel number]" to prompt

What to verify: Outfit details (style / color / accessories / damage state) match first appearance
Pass criteria: Outfit identical to first appearance unless story explicitly requires change (e.g. battle damage)
Fail criteria: Outfit changes without story motivation (e.g. color shifts / accessories appear/disappear)
Fix protocol: Add outfit description verbatim to prompt; use "wearing [exact outfit description]" in every panel prompt

What to verify: Props (weapon / accessory / held item) match first appearance and maintain correct handedness
Pass criteria: Props present when story requires; correct hand; correct orientation
Fail criteria: Prop switches hands; orientation flips (e.g. sword hilt left then right); prop disappears/reappears without motivation
Fix protocol: Add prop description to prompt; specify 'holding in left hand' or 'on back'; reference first appearance panel

What to verify: Character A and B maintain fixed left-right relationship per 180-degree rule
Verification method: Panel sequence review: trace A and B positions across consecutive panels
Pass criteria: A stays on same side (e.g. left) throughout scene unless motivated camera move crosses axis
Fail criteria: A appears on left then right without axis-crossing shot
Fix protocol: Insert neutral shot or camera-move panel to re-establish axis; or re-generate offending panel with corrected positioning

What to verify: Characters and background maintain consistent depth order (foreground / midground / background)
Verification method: Visual scan: check which layer each element occupies
Pass criteria: Depth order matches spatial layout established in establishing panel; no character jumps from background to foreground without motion
Fail criteria: Character depth changes without motion (e.g. appears in background then suddenly foreground in next panel)
Fix protocol: Add "[character] in [depth layer]" to prompt; verify against establishing panel

When to check: After establishing panel and scene transitions
What to verify: Environment elements (skyline / furniture / landmarks / lighting direction) match across all panels of same scene
Verification method: Side-by-side comparison of establishing panel with subsequent panels
Pass criteria: All environmental elements consistent unless scene explicitly changes
Fail criteria: Background elements shift (e.g. window on left becomes window on right); lighting direction flips
Fix protocol: Reference establishing panel in prompt: 'same environment as panel 1'; add 'lighting from [direction]' to every panel

What to verify: Lighting and sky match stated time of day (morning / noon / evening / night)
Verification method: Color temperature check: morning = warm yellow; noon = white; evening = orange-red; night = blue-purple
Pass criteria: Lighting color matches time; shadows direction and length consistent with sun position
Fail criteria: Lighting contradicts time (e.g. bright noon sunlight at night scene); shadows direction inconsistent
Fix protocol: Add 'time of day: [X]' and 'lighting: [color temperature]' to every panel prompt; reference establishing panel

When to check: After establishing panel and scene transitions
What to verify: Weather effects (rain / snow / wind) and season indicators (foliage / clothing thickness) consistent
Pass criteria: Weather effects persist throughout scene unless story explicitly changes season/weather
Fail criteria: Rain starts/stops without transition; character wears winter coat in summer scene without explanation
Fix protocol: Add weather and season descriptors to establishing panel prompt; carry forward to all panels in scene

What to verify: Character motion (movement / attack / gesture) direction consistent across consecutive panels
Verification method: Panel sequence review: trace motion vector from panel to panel
Pass criteria: Motion direction unchanged or logically motivated (e.g. character turns around between panels)
Fail criteria: Motion contradicts previous panel (e.g. running left then suddenly running right without turning)
Fix protocol: Add "motion direction: [vector]" to action panel prompts; verify against previous panel

What to verify: Reaction panel logically follows action panel (cause -> effect)
Verification method: Story logic review: does reaction make sense given the action?
Pass criteria: Reaction matches action intensity and type (e.g. punch -> pain / dodge -> relief)
Fail criteria: Reaction mismatches action (e.g. gentle tap -> extreme overreaction; heavy blow -> no reaction)
Fix protocol: Adjust reaction panel prompt to match action intensity; add "reacting to [previous action]"

What to verify: Character expression transitions logically across emotional beats (e.g. calm -> surprise -> anger -> resolution)
Verification method: Emotion timeline review: map each panel's expression to story beat
Pass criteria: Expression progression follows natural emotional logic; no jarring jumps (e.g. laughing -> crying without intermediate panel)
Fail criteria: Expression jumps unnaturally (e.g. neutral -> sobbing in one panel without trigger)
Fix protocol: Insert intermediate expression panel or adjust prompt with "transitioning from [emotion A] to [emotion B]"

What to verify: Tears / sweat / blush / veins / eye shine appear and disappear consistently
Pass criteria: Micro-details match emotional state; appear when logically triggered and persist appropriately
Fail criteria: Tears appear then vanish without drying; blush on one cheek only; inconsistent eye shine
Fix protocol: Add micro-detail to prompt with timing instruction: "tears forming" / "tears streaming" / "tears drying"; verify against emotional arc

What to verify: Costume / prop damage (tears / burns / blood / dents) accumulates logically and persists
Pass criteria: Damage appears after cause panel and persists until repair; no healing without story reason
Fail criteria: Costume tears then repairs itself; blood disappears; weapon damage vanishes
Fix protocol: Add damage state to prompt: "costume torn at left shoulder from panel 3"; carry forward

What to verify: Items held / worn / carried match inventory established in scene
Pass criteria: All items accounted for; no new items appear without introduction; no items lost without explanation
Fail criteria: Character pulls out item never seen before; item disappears without being dropped or stored
Fix protocol: Track inventory in panel notes; add "holding [item]" or "with [item] on belt" to prompts
